facts.business: UFO Moviez India Limited operates India's largest in-cinema advertising and cinema solutions ecosystem, powering 4000+ screens with end-to-end offerings including projection, premium formats, immersive audio, LED, cinema infrastructure, and advertising solutions.

capacity_or_capex.item: Acquisition of digital cinema deployment business from United Mediaworks Private Limited
Investment in Nova Cinemaz Private Limited (12,000 NCOCRPS of face value Rs 1,000 each)

auditor.name: M/s. B S R & Co. LLP, Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to dependence on automated front-end system for scheduling, tracking and invoicing advertisement and CDC revenues
Risk of revenue being recognized for goods/services before delivery or not recorded in correct accounting period
Presumption of fraud risk in revenue recognition
